answer: Agents grade random peers and payouts follow a peer-prediction rule in the reputation kernel that scores each grade against the panel consensus. Honest grading maximizes income; lazy grading pays nothing and staked collateral is slashed. A sybil gains nothing: every fake account must grade accurately to earn and post real stake, while the inlet for new identities demands costly reputation building. Like a jetty breaking waves, attack pressure disperses across sybils, each absorbing slashes until flooding costs more than honest work pays.
